_comment: Hand-checked calls, keyed by the census row's selector. A key that no longer matches a row is reported by census.mjs as STALE. fill: outline | paper | ink | seal | other:<what>. slice: see SLICES in census.mjs. landed: the slice that moved the row onto Pill; a landed key that matches no row is counted as merge done, not STALE. settled: an outcome other than Pill, such as "moved to Button (slice N)", "moved to Door (slice N)", "deferred to #N", "kept: stamp slot" or "deleted (slice N)"; a settled key counts as settled whether its row still matches or has left the census, and it is never STALE and never merge done.

.prospectpill.reason: identical + gap:4px for the logo; ProspectPill.jsx has 10 importers (incl. offseason/MovedUp.jsx) + a hand-rolled copy in PlayerHubShell.jsx:149-155; two context overrides (.tlead__row .prospectpill, .tradecard__playerinfo .prospectpill) must survive

.tierpill.reason: inventory: outline; inline-block + --ls-caps + line-height:1 are residue

.dlab__verdict.reason: the lab's own capsule; critique: the lab should consume Pill (first real test)

.cwb__badge.reason: admin (contract workbench); no weight, no transform

.favormeter__tierpill.reason: tint on --routine/--standout/--outlier (--standout/--outlier use --award-soft and --marker); raw 999px literal; inside the reveal, same note as .wcall__pill

.flipback__pill.reason: already takes --pill-accent/--pill-text tokens (the target model); --crown is ink (--award-ink). On GameResultFace (a slate flip face, stamp FORBIDDEN_SURFACE) — CSS-only

.team-hub__level.reason: tint of the club's --ink (14% fill / 30% edge) on the themed hero; ADR-0030 lets a club colour an identity surface — pass it as the colour token

.winprob__ledger-chip.reason: fill + ink set INLINE from the club triad (WinProbChart.jsx:597); mono. Solid club fill = the ink fill with a passed colour

.contractcard__regime.reason: navy fill, paper text; carries a drop shadow (paper does not float, #1166) — dropping it is a visible change

.mastheadpill.reason: button with aria-pressed (the 'MLB only' toggle); 3px 8px today, becomes a 34px control. Slice 4: fill="paper", not outline: it rides a club-themed bar (ADR-0030), where a see-through pill would take 30 backdrops

.depthpos.reason: button, mono; selected via .is-active — convert to aria-pressed per #1166

.slate-filterbar__chip.reason: tint from inline --chip-accent (GameSelect.jsx:1137); 1.5px edge (--bw-rule). GameSelect.jsx is a stamp FORBIDDEN_SURFACE — fine, Pill imports nothing stamp-related

.stampstrip__modes button.reason: 32px mode toggle on the Game Log mint strip. Its consumer StampGameButton.jsx IS on check-stamp-surfaces STAMP_ALLOWLIST (one importer: BoxScore.jsx, inside the SealBox reveal). A CSS-only merge is safe; Pill.jsx must never import a stamp module, and the JSX must not move
.stampstrip__modes button.settled: deferred to #1174 (a Button, not a Pill)

.logbookstats__levels button.reason: 34px, mono --fs-small; Logbook stats level filter (stamp-adjacent, no art)

.coverpick__favorite.reason: passport book cover picker; .is-* selected state -> aria-pressed

.trailstrip__followbtn, .trailstrip__sum.reason: 34px already; carries --shadow-card (drop it); no own font-family (inherits body)

.psodds-pill.reason: the 'Postseason odds' button on the club band; navy fill. Inventory said 'seal-filled' — ADR-0083 moved it off kraft

.trrank__jump a.reason: outline drawn ON an ink band (paper ink, 22% paper edge) — the one reversed outline

.photostrip__viewall.reason: sits on a photograph; literal white, not paper — a paper fill would tint on the photo

.wiredock__close.reason: x icon button, 44px wide hit area, no text — an IconButton (Button family, #1130), not a capsule

.gamefindersheet__close.reason: 44x44 x close — radius only rounds the hover/focus ring

.logomodal__close.reason: 32x32 x close, absolute — icon button (a circle)

.infopop__btn.reason: 18x18 italic 'i' — a circle icon button, not a capsule

.posterstudio__save.reason: primary CTA at --fs-body, 12px 20px padding — a Button (btn--primary), not a Pill

.logbook__pending.reason: aspect-ratio:1 dashed CIRCLE = an empty stamp slot on StampCollection.jsx (a STAMP_ALLOWLIST surface). Geometry is the stamp's footprint — leave it alone

.passportpage__pending.reason: same empty stamp slot on PassportPage.jsx (STAMP_ALLOWLIST surface)

.pbp__rbi.reason: DEAD: no JSX consumer anywhere in src/

.penboard__pill.reason: DEAD: no .penboard__* class in any JSX (whole penboard block is orphaned)
